clue.text: Sets great store by compliments

definitions.meaning: to value or hold someone in high regard, a verb
polite greetings, as in 'pay one's regards', a plural noun

explanation.surface: Someone who values flattery very highly.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold in high esteem is one sense; regards or greetings sent to someone is the other.

clue.text: Re-classify a holiday centre

parts.note: to classify things is to sort them into groups

explanation.surface: A holiday destination being given a new rating.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphenated 'Re-classify' looks like one word but splits into RE as written plus SORT.
explanation.definitionFit: A seaside town or spa where people go on holiday is a classic example of the word.

clue.text: Bearing on readily-available drink

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on top of the next

parts.note: a compass bearing such as south, S
something to hand or close by is handy

explanation.surface: A remark about a drink that is easy to get hold of.
explanation.definitionFit: A mix of beer and lemonade is a light pub drink.

clue.text: New pieces — almost all outstanding

indicators.note: something new is in a fresh form, so these letters are rearranged
almost the whole word, so its final letter is dropped

explanation.surface: Fresh items, nearly every one of them excellent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges PIECES into ESPECI; 'almost' drops the last L of ALL to give AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Special or exceptional, notably above the ordinary.

clue.text: Colour a little if caught in the act

indicators.note: only a small portion of the words that follow is taken, a run inside them

explanation.surface: Applying a bit of colour while being caught red-handed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a little' picks a run out of 'caught in the', giving the answer across the word breaks; 'if' and 'act' are only surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A tint is a shade or light hue, and to tint is to give something a hue.

clue.text: It's the current American coinage — emphasise that

parts.note: AC is alternating current
a cent is a US coin

explanation.surface: A remark on modern American money, stressed as important.
explanation.definitionFit: To stress a syllable or point is to give it weight.

clue.text: Talk about the Continental style of building

indicators.note: the first word goes around the other

parts.note: a chat is a talk
LE is French for 'the'

explanation.surface: Discussion of a European architectural style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts LE, the French article, inside CHAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss-style wooden house with overhanging eaves is a recognised kind of building.

clue.text: Using a lever to obtain lift

indicators.note: the letters are put to use in a new order

explanation.surface: Leverage employed to raise something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Using' rearranges the letters of A LEVER TO; 'to obtain' joins it to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevator is the American term for a lift in a building.

clue.text: Held in check — but note the warning sign!

parts.note: TE is a note of the sol-fa scale
red is the colour of danger signals

explanation.surface: Restrained, yet mind the alarm signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Tied up with a rope, so restrained in movement.

clue.text: Taking some photographs and thereby causing a split

explanation.surface: A photographer whose shutter clicks seem to break things.
explanation.definitionFit: Snaps are casual photos; a twig that snaps breaks with a crack.

clue.text: When overdue, a lot of books may be hidden

parts.note: late means behind time
NT, the New Testament, is a collection of many books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Library books not returned on time might be lost from view.
explanation.definitionFit: Dormant or concealed, present but not yet showing.

clue.text: Few cut in front of a driver lacking experience

indicators.note: the first piece is placed ahead of the rest

parts.note: to sever is to cut
L is the learner-driver plate

explanation.surface: A handful slice in front of a novice motorist.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a learner driver must display an L plate.
explanation.definitionFit: A small number, more than two but not many.

clue.text: Lick into shape a revolutionary performance

parts.note: a Red is a communist revolutionary
an act is a performance

explanation.surface: A radical stage show being knocked into shape.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit or prepare a text for publication is to put it in order.

clue.text: Combine bringing a charge about dreadful trade

indicators.note: the charge goes around the other letters

parts.note: a fee is a charge

indicators.note: a dreadful version is a mangled one, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Levying a charge on a terrible business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' rearranges TRADE into DERAT, and 'about' puts FEE around it.
explanation.definitionFit: To unite states or groups into a league is to join them.

clue.text: Send a number on to make a gesture

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a sign is a gesture

explanation.surface: Passing a number on through a hand signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispatch goods or entrust them to someone is to deliver them.

clue.text: Potter around an old German city

indicators.note: the first piece encloses the rest

parts.note: to hover is to hang about idly

explanation.surface: An aimless stroll round an ancient city in Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts AN and O inside HOVER; 'Potter' is a verb here, not a name.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanover is a city in Lower Saxony, Germany.

clue.text: Arrive home cold not hot

indicators.note: the cold letter stands in place of the hot one, so one replaces the other

parts.note: H is the tap abbreviation for hot
C is the tap abbreviation for cold

explanation.surface: Getting back to a chilly house without heating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' signals C taking the place of H in HOME.
explanation.definitionFit: To reach a place is to get there.

clue.text: She is a beautiful Italian

parts.note: bella is Italian for beautiful

explanation.surface: A compliment on a lovely Italian woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'She': the answer is a woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Isabella is a female first name, so it can stand for a woman.

clue.text: Most expeditious about adjusting diet as required

parts.note: RE means concerning, about

indicators.note: the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: The quickest way to change your eating habits as needed.
explanation.definitionFit: The most prompt or willing, the quickest to act.

clue.text: The time to hold vermin back and get rid of the majority

indicators.note: one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: a date is a specified time

indicators.note: the vermin's word is read backwards

parts.note: mice are vermin

explanation.surface: A moment to grip pests and destroy most of them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns MICE into ECIM and 'to hold' puts it inside DATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Strictly killing one in ten, but in common use destroying a large proportion.

clue.text: Interview the little page responsible for leak

parts.note: to see someone is to interview or meet them
P is the abbreviation for page

explanation.surface: Questioning the young servant behind a leak to the press.
explanation.definitionFit: To ooze or trickle slowly out is to escape through small gaps.

clue.text: A man testing for arsenic say with obvious hesitation

parts.note: As is the chemical symbol for arsenic
taken as written
er is the sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: A tester checking for poison while stammering.
explanation.definitionFit: One who analyses metals or ores for purity is an analyst.

clue.text: Stick given as modish present

parts.note: in means fashionable
here means in attendance

explanation.surface: A fashionable gift that will last.
explanation.definitionFit: To be inherent in something is to be fixed or lodged within it.

clue.text: There's some nonsense written about public transport being sound

indicators.note: the nonsense is put down around the transport

parts.note: rot is nonsense
a bus is public transport

explanation.surface: Rubbish published on the buses being judged sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong and healthy, as in a sound constitution.

clue.text: The stationer's dog

definitions.meaning: read as 'the stationer is': one who stations or puts things in place

explanation.surface: The pet belonging to the paper shop owner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stationer' is not the shopkeeper but one who stations things, and the 's is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: One who sets or places things, and a breed of long-haired gundog.

clue.text: Such banter can get hurtful in time

parts.note: bad can mean harmful
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Teasing that can turn nasty over time.
explanation.definitionFit: Light, playful repartee is teasing talk.

clue.text: Hirsute Pole is looking shaggy

indicators.note: shaggy means messy, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hairy man from Poland.
explanation.definitionFit: A botanical and zoological word for covered with hair.

clue.text: Material for the disabled

definitions.meaning: a fabric woven with metallic thread
describing a limb that cannot work properly

explanation.surface: Fabric supplied for those with disabilities.
explanation.definitionFit: Lamé is a glittering fabric; and the plain word means crippled or limping.

clue.text: Songs meant to deceive the monarch

parts.note: lied means told falsehoods
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Tunes designed to fool the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: German art songs for voice and piano, such as Schubert's.

clue.text: Shy on release after doing a stretch

definitions.text: Shy on release after doing a stretch

parts.words: Shy on release after doing a stretch
parts.note: shy means hurl; a sling stretched back flings its stone when let go, while the surface suggests a nervous ex-prisoner

explanation.surface: A timid convict on release after serving time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shy' is a verb, to throw, and 'doing a stretch' is not prison but pulling back elastic.
explanation.definitionFit: A forked stick with elastic for hurling stones: stretch, then let go.

clue.text: Going over the head, branch out

definitions.text: Going over the head, branch out

parts.words: Going over the head, branch out
parts.note: a bony growth on a deer's skull that spreads into tines like a tree's branches

explanation.surface: Advice to bypass the boss and strike out on your own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going over the head' sounds like bypassing a superior, but it is literally above the head of a deer.
explanation.definitionFit: A deer's branched horn sits on top of its head.

clue.text: Badly-fed diner —-he's frustrated

definitions.note: read as 'he has frustrated': the person who thwarted someone, a noun

indicators.note: done badly, so the letters are in the wrong order

parts.note: a diner is an eater

explanation.surface: An underfed restaurant customer feels thwarted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Badly' rearranges FED into DEF; 'he's' is 'he has', so the definition is the one who has thwarted.
explanation.definitionFit: One who beats or foils an opponent is a vanquisher.
